title: Automotive Product Manager - (HW, SW, Mech, HUD/Display, GTM)
description:
**Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Automotive**
We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast-track your career.
  
  

* Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience
* Combine ingenuity, in-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence
* Advance in-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment.

**What You’ll Be Part Of**
**Manager,**
**Product Management**
role is responsible for defining and delivering
**visual experience solutions**
across HARMAN’s automotive display portfolio. This role focuses on creating
**scalable, modular, reusable and differentiated solution offerings (HW + SW + UX)**
that align with OEM needs, consumer expectations, and business objectives.
  
  
You will act as the
**common thread across product lines**
, driving system integration, roadmap alignment, and commercial success of
**solutions and UIUX features that are common across product lines**
.
  
  
**Your Team**
This position reports to Director, Product Management within Strategic Business Unit - Intelligent Cockpit, Product Management Group at HARMAN.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**
**Solution Strategy & Bundled Portfolio Packaging**
Define product roadmap, scope and features for solutions that cut across different product families and manage their lifecycle.
  
  
Define TAM/SAM/SOM, MRD and PRD for such features
  
  
Define solution bundles (e.g., entry, mid, premium cockpit experiences) with clear feature tiers, variants, and upgrade/downgrade paths and price benefits
  
  
Drive platform reuse, modularity, and account for regional customization strategies
  
  
**Cross-Product Integration & Roadmap Alignment**
Manage inter-product dependencies for features that are common across product lines and ensure roadmap coherence and release alignment across product families
  
  
Define scope, requirements and maintain model reference costs for these common UIUX features
  
  
Drive system-level integration across HW, SW, and UX layers for these common UIUX features, managing technical solution differences for the same feature across product families while maximizing reuse
  
  
Drive partnerships, sourcing and manufacturing solutions and decisions including Make & Buy analysis for common features
  
  
Define HMI requirements, solution KPIs and acceptance criteria for common features
  
  
Drive system level testing and validation readiness and chair cross-component issue resolution
  
  
Drive profitability and competitiveness through reuse and optimized content for common features
  
  
**Customer Engagement & Solution Shaping**
Partner with OEMs, Sales, and GTM teams to define bundled solution scope, differentiation, value narrative and trade-offs
  
  
Translate OEM visual experience requirements into solution architectures and promote cross-product selling
  
  
Define bundled pricing strategies, feature monetization, and business models
  
  
**Stakeholder Alignment & Management**
Act as the central point of alignment across other Product managers, Engineering/delivery teams, Supply Chain, Manufacturing and GTM teams for common UIUX features
  
  
Own solution-level demos and reference platforms aligned with roadmap vision
  
  
Develop customer-facing narratives highlighting differentiation, scalability, and value.
  
  
Resolve trade-offs to optimize portfolio-level outcomes
  
  
Manage strategic partners supporting the solutions for these common UIUX features
  
  
**What Makes You A Strong Fit**
**Education**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering, Electronics, Display Technology, Optics, Physics, or related field
* MBA or equivalent business experience is a plus

**Key Skills**

* 6-8+ years of experience specially in product management, system engineering, or hardware development related to displays
* Experience in product or solution management within automotive, cockpit systems, or display technologies
* Strong understanding of Software, Hardware & HMI system integration requirements
* Strong ability to connect OEM needs, UX, and business value into scalable solutions
* Proven experience in cross-functional leadership and system-level thinking
* Strong commercial acumen (costing, pricing, business cases)
* Strong understanding of global market requirements for displays and UX

Be willing to travel domestic and international Be willing to work from office as required Successfully completing a
**background investigation**
and drug screen as a condition of employment
  
  
**Bonus Points if You Have**
Experience with premium automotive cockpit / luxury OEM display programs Product management experience specifically with displays Supplier management exposure Strong familiarity with automotive or consumer display market.
  
  
**What You Can Expect**

* A hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with in-person collaboration, with most office-based roles onsite three days a week.
* Access to employee discounts on HARMAN and Samsung products (including JBL, Harman / Kardon, AKG, and others)
* Learning and development opportunities through our award-winning HARMAN University programs
* Wellness benefits designed to support your overall well-being
* Tuition reimbursement support
* Access to the HARMAN campus fitness center and cafeteria, where available
* An inclusive and diverse work environment that supports both your professional and personal development

**You Belong Here**
HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want.
  
  
**About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next-Level Technology**
Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.
  
  
Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other.
  
  
If you’re ready to innovate and do work that makes a lasting impact, join our talent community today!
  
  
**Important Notice: Recruitment Scams**
Please be aware that HARMAN recruiters will always communicate with you from an '@harman.com', ‘@careers.harman.com’ or ‘harmanglobal.avature.net’ email address. We will never ask for payments, banking, credit card, personal financial information or access to your LinkedIn/email account during the screening, interview, or recruitment process. If you are asked for such information or receive communication from an email address not ending in one of the above email domains about a job with HARMAN, please cease communication immediately and report the incident to us through: harmancareers@harman.com.
  
  
HARMAN is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. HARMAN strives to hire the best qualified candidates and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse marketplaces and communities of our global colleagues and customers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. HARMAN attracts, hires, and develops employees based on merit, qualifications and job-related performance.(www.harman.com)

title: New Product Development Manager
description:
**Job Description: Head – New Product Development (NPD)**
**Position Overview**

The Head of New Product Development (NPD) will lead the end-to-end product development lifecycle—from concept to commercialization—ensuring alignment with customer requirements, cost targets, and manufacturing capabilities. The role demands strong technical expertise in forging and machining processes along with strategic leadership to drive innovation and business growth.

**Key Responsibilities**
**1. Product Development & Execution**

* Lead complete NPD lifecycle: RFQ analysis → feasibility → design → prototyping → validation → PPAP → SOP.
* Drive development of components related to:
* Forged parts
* Precision machined components
* Gear systems (gear cutting & finishing)
* Welded assemblies
* Ensure adherence to customer timelines and APQP milestones.

**2. Technical Feasibility & Engineering**

* Conduct feasibility studies considering:
* Forging design & die development
* Machining cycle time & process optimization
* Gear cutting parameters (hobbing, shaping, grinding)
* Welding processes (MIG/TIG/Spot)
* Collaborate with design and production teams for manufacturability (DFM/DFA).
* Optimize product design for cost, quality, and performance.

**3. Customer Interaction & Business Development**

* Interface with OEM customers for new enquiries and technical discussions.
* Support costing and RFQ submissions with technical inputs.
* Participate in design reviews and customer audits.

**4. Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Work closely with:
* Production
* Quality
* Tool Room
* Purchase & Supply Chain
* Ensure smooth transition from development to mass production.

**5. Process Development & Validation**

* Establish robust manufacturing processes.
* Lead trials, pilot runs, and validation builds.
* Ensure documentation:
* Control Plans
* PFMEA
* Process Flow Diagrams
* Work Instructions

**6. Quality & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with automotive standards (IATF 16949).
* Drive PPAP submissions and approvals.
* Implement root cause analysis and corrective actions.

**7. Costing & Value Engineering**

* Identify cost reduction opportunities through:
* Design optimization
* Alternate materials/processes
* Cycle time reduction
* Support localization and vendor development.

**8. Team Leadership**

* Lead and mentor NPD, design, and process engineering teams.
* Build a high-performance, innovation-driven culture.

**Technical Skill Requirements**
**Core Manufacturing Expertise**

* Forging processes (closed die, hot forging, die design basics)
* CNC machining (turning, milling, VMC/HMC operations)
* Gear manufacturing (hobbing, shaping, shaving, grinding)
* Grinding processes (Cylindrical, Surface, Gear grinding)
* Welding techniques (MIG, TIG, robotic welding preferred)

**Engineering & Design**

* Strong understanding of GD&T and tolerance stack-up
* Hands-on experience with CAD tools (AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Creo)
* Knowledge of simulation tools (preferred)

**Quality & Systems**

* APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC, MSA
* Root cause analysis tools (8D, Why-Why, Fishbone)

**Costing & Process Optimization**

* Knowledge of cost estimation for forged & machined parts
* Lean manufacturing & Six Sigma principles

**Educational Qualification**

* B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering (Mandatory)
* M.Tech or MBA (Operations/Strategy) – Preferred

**Experience**

* 12–18 years in automotive/component manufacturing
* Minimum 5+ years in leadership role in NPD or Engineering
* Experience with OEM customers (e.g., automotive, tractor, off-highway)

**Key Competencies**

* Strategic thinking with strong execution focus
* Excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills
* Strong customer handling and negotiation skills
* Leadership and team-building capability
* High ownership and accountability

**KPIs / Success Metrics**

* On-time NPD project completion (% adherence to timeline)
* PPAP approval success rate
* Cost reduction / value engineering savings
* First-time-right development (minimal rework)
* Customer satisfaction score
* New business revenue contribution

**Reporting Structure**

* Reports to: Plant Head Operations
* Direct Reports: NPD Engineers

title: Product Line Specialist
description:
Requisition Number: 77922
   

  

**The company built on breakthroughs.
   

  

 Join us.**
 Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible.
   

  

 How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward.
   

  

 At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at\-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more.
   

  

 Come break through with us.
   

  

 Corning’s Businesses Are Ever\-evolving To Best Serve Our Customers, Industries, And Consumers. Today, We Accelerate And Transform Life Sciences, Mobile Consumer Electronics, Optical Communications, Display, Automotive, And Solar Markets. We Are Changing The World With
   

  

* Trusted products that accelerate drug discovery, development, and delivery to save lives
* Damage\-resistant cover glass to enhance the devices that keep us connected
* Optical fiber, wireless technologies, and connectivity solutions to carry information and ideas at the speed of light
* Precision glass for advanced displays to deliver richer experiences
* Auto glass and ceramics to drive cleaner, safer, and smarter transportation
* Solar polysilicon, wafers, and innovative photovoltaic modules, enabling low\-cost solar energy solutions


 Purpose of Position
   

  

* Develops and executes a product line strategy that supports the achievement of desired product line sales growth and profitability


 Major Responsibility
   

  

 Works Closely With, Or Leads, a Cross\-functional Product Team Consisting Of Functional Leads From Development, Product Engineering, Applications Engineering, Manufacturing, Marketing And/or Sales To
   

  

* Develop the product or product line’s market value proposition and pricing strategy.
* Develop and execute the product line planning process, including the identification of critical projects to be undertaken for the year.
* Find the optimal solution (balancing the needs of Corning and the customer) to all product issues related to performance (i.e., specs, attributes, services), quality, share growth, customer needs (contract management)
* Create an intellectual property and standards strategy for the product line.
* Understand downstream market requirements and assess competitive threats and implications for the business.
* Create long\-term forecasting plans.
* Works with Program Management or New Business Development to ‘receive’ new products, as appropriate.
* Develops a compelling market value proposition that differentiates Corning’s products and services in the marketplace.
* Develops the product line strategy and manages the product line through the stages of innovation, from product concept through commercialization and life\-cycle management, as appropriate depending on the stage of handoff from Program Management or New Business Development
* May manage a portfolio of markets, in the case where the product line’s products hold different positions within the markets they reach.
* Identifies the best mix for the market(s) through effective segmentation and portfolio rationalization.
* Optimizes inventory management related to the product line by coordinating information flow, as needed, between Forecasting, Sales, Manufacturing, and other parties as needed.
* May get involved in supply chain disruption issues to influence or make decisions on global order and Development/Manufacturing prioritization.
* Works with Manufacturing and Sales to identify opportunities to reduce complexity and cost reduction in the manufacturing process both at Corning’s plant(s) and the customer site, as appropriate.
* Works with the Standards group to set and drive the standards strategy for the product line.
* Addresses new product/special requests by developing a business case (including P\&L and balance sheet implications) to determine the feasibility and pricing requirements of the requests.
* Owns and optimizes, or may work with the Pricing Manger to optimize, pricing levels by setting floor price, establishing pricing structure, optimizing product premiums, and ensuring value received for product line
* Works with Account Management to develop value propositions that improve margins for Corning’s products and services and enable new/enhanced selling opportunities with customers.
* Manages the obsolescence process, as necessary, to extract maximum value through the end of the product’s lifecycle.
* May oversee, develop, and direct a Product Line team.


 Education \& Experience
   

  

* Bachelor’s Degree \- Technical (engineering degree or other formal engineering education)
* MBA desired
* Intermediate Project Management Skills and Practices
* Product / Process Knowledge
* Customer Knowledge


**Required Competency (Skills, Knowledge And Abilities)**
* Demonstrated track record of managing projects.
* Demonstrated track record of leading and/or actively participating in multi\-functional teams.
* Fluent English written and spoken. Knowledge of additional Asian language knowledge is a plus.
* Good knowledge of Excel spreadsheets and MS Office in general
* Optical Industry Acumen is a plus.
* Technology around the Data Center including cabling and actives/networking are a plus.
